comment: What a club page says about its forecast, for every combination of: a forecast to show, older than 3 hours (out of date), an update running, the last load failed. Written down once for the app (ios/RowFrog/ForecastStatus.swift, read by ios/RowFrogTests/ForecastStatusTests.swift) and the website (web/public/app/logic.js forecastStatus, read by web/tests/forecaststatus.test.mjs); change all three together. Owner decision 11 Nov 2026: out of date and a failed update show together. outOfDate without a forecast to show means nothing.

states.loading: Nothing to show yet: stand-in cards.
states.noForecast: Nothing to show: the reason and Try again.
states.updating: Updating… (app only; the website reloads the whole page).
states.outOfDate: Forecast out of date: from <day, time>.
states.updateFailed: Could not update: <reason>. Showing data from <time>.
states.outOfDateAndUpdateFailed: Both lines: out of date, then Could not update with <day, time>.
